name: smart-video-encoder
$comment-baseline: builtin-baseline rather than a git default-registry in vcpkg-configuration.json: the
latter makes vcpkg fetch the whole registry over the network on first configure, even
when VCPKG_ROOT already is that clone. Measured here at over seven minutes and still
running. builtin-baseline pins the same versions using the checkout that is already
there, which every consumer has anyway.
Add vcpkg-configuration.json when there is something for it to carry -- an overlay port
or a second registry. A file that exists only to match a directory listing, and costs a
network clone to do it, is worse than its absence.
